verdict.rationale: Notte ships its own web agents that take natural-language tasks and carry them out on websites. The evidence for this includes "Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt" and "Give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites." There is also an agent-start API to "run web ai agents to act on your behalf," and live view lets you watch the agent execute. One community user reported a failed extraction on hyatt.com, which raises reliability concerns but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: clear documentation of an in-product conversational assistant UI for delegating tasks, and independent corroboration of reliable task completion.
